RCP.title: Runyth Cycle Portrait
RCP.empty: No image files were found. Set a portrait image pattern, or place multiple images beside the current Actor portrait.
RCP.patternLabel: Actor portrait image path or wildcard
RCP.defaultPattern: Automatic: folder of current Actor portrait
RCP.patternHint: Accepts one image path or a wildcard such as portraits/hero/Head_*.webp. Leave blank for automatic discovery. This does not change token art or enable token randomization.
RCP.resetGeometry: Reset saved picker window position and size
RCP.resetDone: The picker will use its default dimensions the next time it opens.

intro.heading: Overview
intro.body: Open the Token HUD and select the frame emoji to choose the source Actor's portrait. The Actor image changes only when you select a new thumbnail.

setup.heading: Image discovery
setup.body: With no custom pattern, portrait candidates are discovered beside the Actor's current image. For full control set a path or wildcard in Actor → Prototype Token → Appearance, or use the advanced gallery source panel.

pattern.heading: Path patterns
pattern.body: Examples: portraits/hero/Head_*.webp, portraits/hero/*.{png,webp}, portraits/hero/Head_1.jpg. One exact image path shows one candidate. File listing depends on your Foundry file-storage permissions.

defaults.heading: Safe defaults
defaults.body: Installation does not alter existing Actor images, token textures, prototype token configuration, or image-randomization settings. Changes are explicit and limited to the Actor portrait.

permission.heading: Permissions
permission.body: A GM may modify any Actor. Other users need ownership of the Actor and the triggering token, and the world's player-permission setting must allow changes.

shortcuts.heading: Gallery controls
shortcuts.body: Filename search is available by default. Enable regex via the asterisk. The advanced view adds navigation, refresh, Help and an Actor-specific pattern editor. The gallery shows large, genuinely transparent image thumbnails. Filename captions are optional; selected images are indicated by a border only. When Cycle Token is active, the portrait control sits immediately below its button.

hud.name: Show portrait button on Token HUD
hud.hint: Show the portrait selector on tokens whose Actors may be edited.

owners.name: Allow owning players to edit portraits
owners.hint: When off, only GMs may change an Actor's portrait using this module.

icon.name: Portrait HUD icon
icon.hint: Choose a HUD emoji, Font Awesome icon, or bundled original vector artwork.

advanced.name: Use advanced gallery
advanced.hint: Expose previous/next, refresh, help, and Actor portrait pattern controls.

captions.name: Show image filenames
captions.hint: Only when enabled, show one filename caption beneath each image; there are no other image footers.

tooltips.name: Show thumbnail hover tooltips
tooltips.hint: Display image filenames without extensions in hover tooltips.

linked.name: Link thumbnail width and height
linked.hint: Legacy preference, retained only for migration.

width.name: Thumbnail width
width.hint: Legacy width, retained only for migration.

height.name: Thumbnail height
height.hint: Legacy height, retained only for migration.

opacity.name: Picker window background opacity
opacity.hint: 0 makes the window backdrop fully transparent while controls, captions, and images stay opaque.

help.name: Portrait gallery Help
help.label: Open Help
help.hint: Open an accessible guide to portrait selection and wildcard patterns.

thumbnail.menuHint: Use one slider for width and height, or enable separate sliders. Saved independently for each world user.
thumbnail.description: Resize the images in your portrait picker. Normally one slider controls both dimensions; enable separate sliders when needed. Portrait proportions are preserved.
thumbnail.separate: Use separate width and height sliders
thumbnail.hint: 85–245 px. Changes immediately resize thumbnails and tiles in open portrait galleries; the actual Actor portraits are unaffected.
